description: This file contains functions and types related to plugin runtime boundary management, including resolving plugin records, module paths, and loading modules with Jiti, specific to the runtime plugin boundary in the openclaw project.

methods.name: readPluginBoundaryConfigSafely
methods.description: Safely loads plugin boundary configuration, returning an empty object if loading fails.

methods.name: resolvePluginRuntimeRecord
methods.description: Resolves a plugin's runtime record by plugin ID, optionally calling onMissing if not found.

methods.name: resolvePluginRuntimeRecordByEntryBaseNames
methods.description: Finds a plugin runtime record matching given entry base names, ensuring unambiguous resolution.

methods.name: resolvePluginRuntimeModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for a plugin runtime module based on record and entry base name.

methods.name: getPluginBoundaryJiti
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Jiti loader for a plugin module, with alias resolution.

methods.name: loadPluginBoundaryModuleWithJiti
methods.description: Loads a plugin module using a Jiti loader.

methods.name: createCachedPluginBoundaryModuleLoader
methods.description: Creates a cached loader function for plugin boundary modules, handling missing plugins and paths.
